title: Page load error has mojibake characters: "The URL canâ€™t be shown"
body:
STR:
I entered `802.11` in the Focus (7.0) address bar, trying to search for the [Wikipedia page about IEEE 802.11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_802.11). Focus interrupted `802.11` as an address (IP or domain name, I don't know).

ACTUAL RESULT:
Focus shows an error page with mojibake characters: `The URL canâ€™t be shown`.

EXPECTED RESULT:
In Firefox for iOS, entering `802.11` loads a WebKit error page showing `The URL can’t be shown`. Or the browser could just treat invalid addresses as search terms, which might find a link to an appropriate page. However, some users might consider it a privacy violation.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: I think the character issue will be solved with the fix for #1382 but should watch.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Looks to me to be fixed with #1409, going out with 8.0. Thanks for filing!
